Name in Other Languages

Korean

다락방의 꼬마 재봉사
(darakppange kkoma jaebongsa)

“ Making clothes is so much fun! Would you like me to make one for your toy? „

Attic's Little Stitcher (Korean: 다락방의 꼬마 재봉사, darakppange kkoma jaebongsa) is Lollipop Cookie's second Costume, released in the second half of the Holiday Training Academy Exam update. It is a Super Epic Costume that can be obtained either by drawing it from the Costume Gacha or by purchasing it in the Rainbow Crystal Shop.

Story

In the attic of the Merrybear Toy Shop, there resides a talented stitcher! On holiday eve night, toys dressed in winter clothes crafted by Lollipop Cookie wake up and start dancing to the rhythmic hum of the sewing machine. Perhaps the Cookie wishes to share the wonders of the holiday miracle she remembers receiving from one kindhearted Cookie.

Trivia

  • Attic's Little Stitcher was released alongside  Northern Forest Keeper and  Snowball Guide.

Name in Other Languages

Korean

첫눈 오는 날
(cheosnun oneun nal)
"First Snow Day"

“ Everyone, come out! The Temple is filled with snow! „

First Snow (Korean: 첫눈 오는 날, cheosnun oneun nal, "First Snow Day") is Lollipop Cookie's first Costume, released accompanying her release in the first half of The Lost Holiday update. It is a Champion Costume that can be obtained by drawing it from the Vintage Costume Jar in the Gem Exchange Center.

Story

On the day of the finals in the Celestial Temple, the skies were filled with the first snow of the year! Lollipop Cookie, having looked forward to this happening all year, ran outside first of all, even before the sun had risen. With all the snowflakes almost resembling beautiful flowers, perhaps this is the way heaven congratulates the winner!

Trivia

  • Previously, First Snow was only obtainable by spending Champion Season Points during the Lollipop Season in Trophy Race: Champions League.
  • As of the Falling Constellation Rescue! update, the line "Temple of the Sky" in First Snow's description was changed to "Celestial Temple".
